items.title: fix: keep waiting while Gateway restart startup advances (#189364)
items.summary: fix: keep waiting while Gateway restart startup advances (#189364) ## What Problem This Solves `gateway restart` can stop waiting at 60 seconds even after the replacement reports a new startup phase and becomes healthy shortly afterward. Related: #161158 ## User Impact Restarts and Doctor restoration keep observing a progressing startup within the existing five-minute cap. Verified readiness succeeds; failed and unverified outcomes retain their distinct nonzero exit codes. This covers native restart progress. The source updater's arbitrary shell callback/exit-2 contract and native `gateway start` deadline remain unresolved parts of #161158, so this PR does not close it. A silent pre-listener startup cannot earn progress credit without observable migration activity. ## Why This Change Was Made Count each new `/startupz` phase from the running replacement's own listener in the existing progress watchdog. Repeated phases, foreign listeners, and a later process cannot renew the window. Explicit deadlines, migration progress, identity/health checks, and the cap remain unchanged; no timeout increase or new configuration. The original exit-0-on-failure defect is already repaired on main. Add a stopped-replacement regression through the CLI failure reporter to preserve exit 1, alongside the existing pending/success contracts. ## Evidence - RED on main: startup changes phase at 45s and is healthy at 90s; the observer returns `still-starting` at 60s. GREEN with this repair. - 230 focused tests passed: 194 readiness/lifecycle/diagnostic tests plus 36 Doctor/update consumer tests. Controls cover no progress, replayed phases, a foreign listener, a changed PID, an explicit deadline, a dead replacement, and failure/pending exit codes. Commands used timeout, nice/ionice, and one Vitest worker; combined wrapper wall time was 61.74s, including test-worker compilation. [CI run 41200798470](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41200798470) passed, including the aggregate CI gate; creation-to-completion wall time was 8m25s. Security checks passed. - Targeted services typecheck, three-file lint, formatting, test-line ratchet, and diff checks passed. - pr-simplify completed: reuse the existing watchdog and owner; net +19 production lines and +78 regression-test lines. The separate test-line allocation covers those distinct regression boundaries without changing the shared ceiling. - Independent Codex P0–P2 autoreview: **scoped-clean**, no actionable findings, covering base `140e7af6627723fd50b8ecf51927d80e77b4daa9` through the final local candidate committed unchanged as `40ee7ea8b9b37972c1c0d20243f0f21b733de887`. Full waiter, changed tests, and unchanged probe/lifecycle contracts were supplied; the reviewer did not execute tests. - No real Gateway/services, containers, product builds, or installed-upgrade proof were run, per the task constraints. HTTP/RPC/native process I/O is fixture-controlled; these tests do not claim live startup measurements. ## Work sessions [Implementation and verification](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/~key/dashboard/78580230-7d1b-4329-a7dd-72554eb66323) Co-authored-by: steipete
